final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transaction_id, t.ordertypedist AS order_mix, AVG(s.instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT order_mix, AVG(avg_ownership) AS mix_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY order_mix), step3 AS (SELECT a.transaction_id, a.order_mix, a.avg_ownership, a.avg_ownership / b.mix_avg AS ownership_ratio FROM step1 AS a JOIN step2 AS b ON a.order_mix = b.order_mix COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT a.transaction_id, a.order_mix, a.avg_ownership, a.ownership_ratio, a.avg_ownership - b.overall_avg AS ownership_difference FROM step3 AS a JOIN step4 AS b ON b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE a.avg_ownership > b.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ownership), AVG(ownership_ratio), AVG(ownership_difference) FROM step5
